cases.name: Concurrent valid PATCH requests persist mutual parent cycle in real PostgreSQL
Actual org-chart GET omits ACTIVE employee attached to the persisted cycle

scope: Actual PATCH/GET/chain validator and real isolated full-schema PostgreSQL. Synthetic authenticated ADMIN context; explicit update barrier reproduces a valid concurrency interleaving. Unix-only private DB; no production/customer/provider writes. This confirms defects; it is not a successful repair.
